{{Quote|These troops are brutal alien mercenaries of the exiled Lord Tytonus. Students of Sith politics will remember she was the rebel who declared her own kingdom on Begeren.|[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Shellaster (major)|Shellaster]]|<ref name="TOR:FoO" />}}
During the era of the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tytonus]] [[Tytonus's revolution|rebelled]] against the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and [[Dark Council]] by declaring a '''kingdom''' of her own. Tytonus's new dominion was based on [[Begeren]] and relied on a mercenary army for martial defense.<ref name="TOR:FoO" />
